subunit: Efficient DNA binding requires dimerization with another bHLH protein. Binds DNA as a heterodimer with MAX. Interacts with TAF1C and SPAG9. Interacts with PARP10. Interacts with KDM5A and KDM5B. Interacts (when phosphorylated at Thr-73 and Ser-77) with FBXW7. Interacts with PIM2. Interacts with RIOX1. The heterodimer MYC:MAX interacts with ABI1; the interaction may enhance MYC:MAX transcriptional activity. Interacts with TRIM6. Interacts with NPM1; the binary complex is recruited to the promoter of MYC target genes and enhances their transcription. Interacts with CIP2A; leading to the stabilization of MYC. Interacts with NUP205. Interacts with HEATR1; the interaction is required for localization of MYC to the nucleolus

complexes.name: FOXO3-MYC complex
complexes.function: A transcription factor repressor complex involved in regulating cell proliferation by repressing transcription of genes involved in negative regulation of mitotic cell cycle. The interaction of MYC with FOXO3 is likely to occur at the target gene promoter and inhibits FOXO3s activating effect on target gene transcription. The half life of the FOXO3-MYC complex is not known, but most likely to be of limited time span, in line with rapid dynamics of changes in transcription regulation in response to internal and external cues. Another variant of FOXO3-MYC interaction has been observed where FOXO3 seems to facilitate displacement of MYC from its promoters, thereby antagonizing MYC function in metabolic adaption to hypoxia.
complexes.properties: Interaction with DNA is specifically via FOXO3 subunit.

complexes.name: c-MYC-BIN1 complex
complexes.function: Transcriptional suppressor complex. Binding of BIN1 to c-MYC inhibits the transcription factor activity of c-MYC and the complex thus acts as a tumor suppressor.
complexes.properties: BIN1 interacts with c-Myc via its c-Myc binding domain. The c-MYC-BIN1 interaction can be inhibited by phosphorylation of c-Myc at Ser-62. Alternative splicing of the Bin1 transcript results in ubiquitous, tissue-specific and tumor-specific isoforms of Bin1 proteins.

complexes.name: MYC-MAX transcriptional activator complex
complexes.function: Proto-oncogenic transcriptional activator recognizing E box hexanucleotides containing the DNA consensus sequence CACGTG within gene promoters. The MYC-MAX heterodimer upregulates gene transcription by interaction with TATA binding protein (TBP, P20226), which in turn upregulates RNA polymerase transcription of the gene. Role in cellular proliferation and division.
complexes.properties: On binding to its obligatory partner MAX, a bHLHZip protein, the C-terminal domain of the intrinsically disordered protein MYC forms an ordered alpha-helical structure that extends into a left-handed coiled coil formed by the two leucine zipper motifs This stable four-helix bundle binds to specific DNA sequences, such as CACGTG E-box motifs. The dimerization event is driven by the leucine zipper and the HLH motifs, while the basic regions interact with DNA. The complex may dimerize to form a bivalent heterotetramer. which may enable the complex to engage multiple cognate sites.
